title: Question words; अस्ति/नास्ति; आम्/न

video.title: किम्? कुत्र? कति? कदा? कुतः? कथम्? किमर्थम्?
video.focus: Pause after each question word and say its Hindi meaning out loud before the video does.

recap: Your Day 18 quiz answers didn't come in, and the Day 17 and 18 lessons never reached this site, so here is a warm-up from Day 16. W1: Say 'We (three or more) read'. W2: Which goes with युवाम्: पठथः or पठथ? W3: Translate: They (many) run.
idea: Today you learn to **ask** questions. Most Sanskrit question words start with **क-**, just as most Hindi ones do (कब, कहाँ, कैसे, कितने).
- किमर्थम् kimartham - why? literally 'for what purpose' (क्यों)
- किम् kim - what? (Day 14). At the start of a sentence it also turns a statement into a yes/no question: किं त्वं पठसि? = Do you read? (क्या तुम पढ़ते हो?)
कुत्र, कदा, कथम् and किमर्थम् are **indeclinables** (अव्यय avyaya): words that never change their form, whatever the gender or number. कति is always plural.
A question word can stand anywhere; most often it comes before the verb: पिता कुत्र अस्ति?
- नास्ति nāsti - is not, there is no (नहीं है). It is न + अस्ति joined: the two a's merge into ā. You'll learn this joining (sandhi) properly on Day 46.
- न na - no, not (नहीं). Put it just before the verb: अहं न गच्छामि = I don't go.
**Sound tip:** Hindi speech drops the final a (कब, कहाँ). In Sanskrit say every vowel: ku-tra, ka-dā, ka-tham. And remember: before a consonant, final म् is written ं: कथं वदति, किमर्थं धावति.
The video also uses कुतः (from where?). Keep it in mind; you'll use it with the 5th case on Day 23.

sayAloud.dev: अहं कुत्र गच्छामि? अहं विद्यालयं गच्छामि।
sayAloud.iast: ahaṃ kutra gacchāmi? ahaṃ vidyālayaṃ gacchāmi
sayAloud.meaning: Where am I going? I am going to school.

sayAloud.dev: किं पुस्तकम् अत्र अस्ति? आम्, अस्ति।
sayAloud.iast: kiṃ pustakam atra asti? ām, asti
sayAloud.meaning: Is the book here? Yes, it is.
Today I study Sanskrit. Your turn: one sentence about your own day, then ask yourself a question about it with कुत्र or कदा.

quiz.why: कदा = when (कब). कुत्र = where; कथम् = how.

quiz.q: Which sentence means 'There is no book here'?
quiz.why: नास्ति = न + अस्ति, 'is not'. (b) says the book IS here; (c) asks where it is.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: त्वं ___ गच्छसि? (Where are you going?)

quiz.why: किमर्थम् = 'for what purpose', i.e. why (क्यों). How = कथम्; how many = कति.

quiz.q: Translate into Sanskrit: Where is the water?
quiz.why: जलम् (water) + कुत्र (where) + अस्ति (is). Before क, जलम् is written जलं.
